description: This file defines the interface for TR181 parameter management, including data types, error codes, and function prototypes for getting, setting, and clearing parameters, as well as error string retrieval. It also includes conditional compilation for Google Test support.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves the value and type of a specified TR181 parameter.

methods.name: setParam
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified TR181 parameter.

methods.name: clearParam
methods.description: Clears or resets a specified TR181 parameter or domain.

methods.name: getTR181ErrorString
methods.description: Returns a string description for a given TR181 error code.

methods.name: clearLocalParam
methods.description: Clears or resets a local parameter.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the default value for a parameter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets a parameter value from a file (GTEST only).

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Converts a data type to TR181 parameter type (GTEST only).

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Converts WDMP status to TR181 error code (GTEST only).
